text.tspan: Encouragement — For Fellowship with the Lord
As David cared for sheep out on the hills,
He prayed and sang and how his heart was filled!
Bravely he face a lion and a bear,
Shielding the sheep from ev’ry danger there.
Sing, sing, sing! YES, sing unto the Lord!
Sing from our heart and strike a joyful chord!
Cheerfully we sing: it makes our faces grin!
Sing to the Lord again and again.
